WITH usable AS (
  SELECT stop_code, phase_name, source_id,
         SUM(unload_seconds) OVER phase AS pooled_seconds,
         SUM(crate_count) OVER phase AS pooled_crates
  FROM stop_report
  WHERE unload_seconds IS NOT NULL AND crate_count > 0
    AND phase_name IN ('before', 'pilot')
  WINDOW phase AS (PARTITION BY stop_code, phase_name)
), totals AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT stop_code, phase_name, pooled_seconds, pooled_crates FROM usable
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT b.stop_code
  FROM totals AS b JOIN totals AS p ON p.stop_code = b.stop_code
  WHERE b.phase_name = 'before' AND p.phase_name = 'pilot'
    AND p.pooled_seconds * b.pooled_crates < b.pooled_seconds * p.pooled_crates
)
SELECT u.stop_code, u.phase_name, u.source_id, u.pooled_seconds, u.pooled_crates
FROM usable AS u JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.stop_code = u.stop_code
ORDER BY u.stop_code COLLATE BINARY, u.phase_name COLLATE BINARY, u.source_id COLLATE BINARY

WITH bookings AS (
  SELECT block_code AS first_block, NULL AS second_block, ready_bins AS filled_bins, 1 AS visits
  FROM shaker_offer
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.block_code, b.block_code, a.ready_bins + b.ready_bins, 2
  FROM shaker_offer AS a JOIN shaker_offer AS b ON a.finish_min <= b.start_min
)
SELECT b.first_block, b.second_block, b.filled_bins, c.card_id
FROM bookings AS b CROSS JOIN dispatch_card AS c
WHERE b.filled_bins <= c.bin_limit
ORDER BY b.filled_bins DESC, b.visits, b.first_block COLLATE BINARY, b.second_block COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-book-uninterrupted-tug-charge:
SELECT t.source_id, a.hour_no AS start_hour, t.draw_kw * (a.price_cents + b.price_cents) AS cost_cents
FROM feeder_quote AS a
JOIN feeder_quote AS b ON b.hour_no = a.hour_no + 1 AND b.hour_no / 24 = a.hour_no / 24
CROSS JOIN tug_order AS t
WHERE a.spare_kw >= t.draw_kw AND b.spare_kw >= t.draw_kw
ORDER BY cost_cents, start_hour
LIMIT 1
